title: What happened in AI — Oct 3, 2026
intro: Apple tightened macOS full-disk access to curb abuse by AI agents, a sign that OS vendors now treat agent permissions as a security boundary.
On the tooling side, three Show HN launches target running coding agents from one place, and DoorDash described moving its GenAI platform from vendor-first to open-weights models.
highlights: Apple changes full-disk access permissions to limit what AI agents can reach on macOS.
Offrun runs Claude Code, Codex, AGY, and Grok Build side by side and shows per-account usage left.
A hosted MCP bridge lets Claude or ChatGPT steer a coding agent on your own machine.
AgentMachinist makes a coding agent show its work.
DoorDash shares its GenAI platform architecture, including the shift from vendor-first to open-weights models.

categories.name: Coding-Agent Control Planes
